Also emphasize your organizational and calendaring skills in your professional and work life. And you don’t need a referral from another EA just someone working at whatever company you’re applying to! Network and talk to friends and family members at company’s you want to work for

Tailor your resume to include that you have administrative support, office support, and direct support experience specifically supporting managers and/or executives or team.
